paragraphs: MuniPro sells a workstation for municipal finance built on the record of each issuer's debt, covering every series and maturity, every refunding and defeasance, and obligations that never carried a CUSIP. Fourteen named tools sit on one system of record, and market data is sourced and stamped so results are reproducible.

The workspace groups debt management, debt structuring, refunding scenarios, market data, option pricing and bond holders, each reading from the same record. Debt structuring toggles between level debt, wrap-around and ascending structures and layers reserve funds, capitalized interest and bond insurance. Option pricing runs a Black-Derman-Toy binomial tree for option-adjusted spreads with custom volatility, short-rate and curve assumptions.

Five roles share one workspace: investment bankers, underwriters, credit analysts, municipal advisors and portfolio managers. Each module replaces a single-purpose subscription on a typical desk, and bought together they are described as cheaper than any two of the legacy tools. Government finance officers are pointed to BondGov, a free sister platform for state and local issuers, with no charge for any government in the U.S.

quote.text: Fourteen named tools. One system of record.
